title: Talent Acquisition Associate - Maternity Leave
HR Recruitment Consultant
description:
Overview \& Responsibilities:
**Background**
==============


IDLO is seeking an experienced Recruitment Consultant to provide specialized recruitment and HR administrative services to the recruitment effort to support implementation of the Dutch\-funded MYROLS programme in the Sahel region. The Consultant will support the end\-to\-end recruitment and selection process for assigned vacancies across IDLO's operations, ensuring the timely identification and selection of qualified talent in accordance with IDLO's recruitment policies and guidelines.

  

Reporting to the Head of HR Operations (the "Coordinator"), the Consultant will perform the following services:

**Recruitment and Selection:**
------------------------------

* Support the end\-to\-end recruitment process for assigned vacancies, including:
* Launching vacancy announcements in IDLO's Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and on relevant recruitment platforms, as required.
* Screening applications against vacancy requirements and established selection criteria.
* Preparing longlist reports and candidate assessments for review by hiring managers.
* Supporting hiring managers in the development of shortlists.
* Conducting candidate pre\-screening interviews and coordinating technical assessments and tests, where applicable.
* Scheduling interviews and serving as a member of interview panels, as required.
* Drafting recruitment reports and maintaining complete recruitment documentation for assigned vacancies.
* Ensuring compliance with IDLO recruitment policies, procedures, and timelines throughout the selection process.

**Candidate Evaluation and Employment Offer:**
----------------------------------------------

* Conducting reference checks for shortlisted finalists.
* Preparing and issuing employment offers to selected candidates.
* Liaising with candidates throughout the recruitment process to ensure a positive candidate experience.

**Reporting and Coordination:**
-------------------------------

* Providing regular updates to the Head of HR Operations on the status of assigned recruitments.
* Reporting on the quality and diversity of candidate pools, progress of screening activities, recruitment challenges, and recommended actions.
* Participating in regular coordination meetings with HR and hiring managers.

**Deliverables**
================


The Consultant will be responsible for the timely delivery of:

* Vacancy announcement drafting and publication.
* Longlist and shortlist reports for assigned vacancies.
* Candidate screening and assessment documentation.
* Interview coordination and panel participation.
* Reference check reports.
* Recruitment reports and selection documentation.
* Employment offers and contracts for selected candidates.
* Periodic recruitment status updates.


Job Requirements:
**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, International Relations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3\-4 years of progressively responsible experience in talent acquisition, recruitment, and human resources.
* Demonstrated experience managing full\-cycle recruitment processes in international organizations, NGOs, intergovernmental organizations, or similar multicultural environments.
* Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment technologies.
* Prior professional experience and/or demonstrated knowledge of the Sahel region will be considered a distinct advantage.

**Languages**
-------------

* Excellent written and spoken **French** and **English** are required.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong interviewing, candidate assessment, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent organizational and planning abilities with the capacity to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and deliver results within tight deadlines.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Works well with others and actively participates. Shares information, contributes, encourages and motivates others to become involved in team activities.
* Keen sense of ethics, integrity, and commitment to IDLO’s mandate..


Terms \& Conditions:

This consultancy may be home\-based but ideally based at IDLO Headquarters in Rome. The Consultant will independently manage assigned recruitment processes and deliverables while ensuring timely and high\-quality support to hiring managers and the HR team. Throughout the assignment, the Consultant will provide regular updates to the coordinator and the specific Hiring Manager (s) on the status of assigned vacancies, including progress on candidate sourcing and screening activities, the quality and diversity of candidate pools, and any recruitment\-related challenges or risks.

  

The consultancy period, level of effort, remuneration, and payment schedule will be specified in the consultancy contract. Payments will be linked to the satisfactory completion and approval of agreed deliverables in accordance with IDLO's contractual procedures.

  

All work produced under this assignment, including reports, datasets, interview records, analytical tools, presentations, and supporting documentation, shall become the property of IDLO. The consultant shall maintain strict confidentiality regarding all information obtained during the assignment and comply with IDLO's policies on research ethics, data protection, safeguarding, and information security.

  

IDLO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds. Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply for IDLO vacancies.  

IDLO does not tolerate sexual exploitation or abuse, any kind of harassment, including harassment of a sexual nature, or discrimination. As such, IDLO will conduct careful reference and background checks of all selected candidates as part of its selection process. **Application deadline: 30 August 2026** (23:59hrs Rome Time)

description:
### **Chi siamo**



Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.



Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.


### **Come lavoriamo**



Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.

Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.


### **Cosa troverai in Octopus**



Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.

  

### **Il ruolo**



Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.



In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.



Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.



È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.



Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

  


### **Cosa farai**

* **Renderai l’energia più semplice.** Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.



\\uD83D\\uDCA1 **Troverai soluzioni concrete.** Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.



\\uD83D\\uDCDE **Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine.** Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e\-mail e su WhatsApp.



\\uD83E\\uDDE0 **Ragionerai con la tua testa.** Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.



❤️ **Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna.** Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.



\\uD83C\\uDF0D **Farai la differenza.** Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

* Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.
* Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.
* Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.
* Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.
* Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

### **Perché ti piacerà lavorare qui**

* In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati
* Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

* Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

### **Cos'altro ti piacerà qui da noi**

description:

**Organizational Setting**
--------------------------



**The advertised position is Co\-terminus, i.e., subject to a limited duration and contingent on project funding. The successful candidate will be offered a co\-terminus appointment, the duration of which is strictly limited to the period of funding for the specific project and/or assignment. Any extension, if applicable, will be contingent upon the continued availability of the same funding source, the continued existence of the position, and operational needs. Co\-terminus appointments are also subject to a maximum total duration of seven years, including any contract extensions. This type of appointment does not carry any expectation \- legal or otherwise \- of conversion to any other type of appointment with IFAD, regardless of length of service.**

**Staff members holding an IFAD fixed\-term or indefinite appointment are eligible to apply for this co\-terminus position, with their terms and conditions of employment, including contractual status, remaining unchanged. Given that the funding of this position is strictly limited in duration and conditional upon the availability of supplementary funds, should the funding cease, the position will be abolished and the staff member concerned will be subject to the relevant provisions set out in the HR Implementing Procedures**


The International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) is an international financial institution and a specialized United Nations agency dedicated to eradicating rural poverty and hunger. It does so by investing in rural people. IFAD finances programmes and projects that increase agricultural productivity and raise rural incomes, and advocates at the local, national and international level for policies that contribute to rural transformation.


The Office of Technical Delivery is responsible for providing expert technical guidance to IFAD teams engaged in the design and implementation of projects and programmes to deliver the high technical quality investments that facilitate rural transformation, and which comply with IFAD's mandate and operational policies. The Office ensures IFAD applies and disseminates state of the art knowledge in its investments and evidence on strategic themes and encourages the innovative application of global knowledge and evidence in IFAD investments. This helps countries tackle complex development challenges in fostering inclusive and sustainable rural transformation including mainstreaming areas. The Office of Technical Delivery (OTD) is led by a Managing Director and is comprised of two (2\) divisions: the Environment, Climate and Peoples Division (ECP) and the Production, Markets and Infrastructure Division (PMI).


The Production, Markets and Infrastructure Division (PMI) facilitates improved and efficient delivery of IFAD's corporate mandate, predominantly through the quality of the design and implementation of its policies, country strategies and projects. Key functions and activities of PMI include Quality Enhancement, Policy Engagement, Networking and Strategic Partnerships. PMI's technical mandate covers a range of themes, all of which are key to deliver IFAD's strategic framework, including: agronomy, livestock, fisheries and aquaculture, markets and value chains, agriculture research for development (AR4D), ICT4D, inclusive rural finance (including PARM, INSURED and remittances), rural institutions and farmers organizations, rural infrastructure, water, land and natural resources management.


PMI is led by a Divisional Director and is comprised of four (4\) units: Production \& Nutrition Unit; Land \& Water Unit; Value Chains \& Technology Unit; and Rural Finance Unit.


The Agribusiness Linkages Facility (Agri\-Link) creates direct partnerships between IFAD's donor partners, smallholder farmers and the private sector. Together with local and international agribusinesses, it implements targeted, time\-bound interventions that strengthen these companies\- supply chains by improving farmers\- ability to meet market requirements. The facility supports private investment in rural areas and contributes to higher farmer income, improved food security and rural employment.


**Job Role**
------------



The incumbent is a professional in a specialized thematic area, reporting either to a more senior Technical Specialist or to the divisional Director. At this level Technical Specialists analyse technical and policy problems of concern to IFAD, intergovernmental bodies, and national authorities and provide technical input to the development of policies, technical strategies and proposals and project implementation. The incumbent may work collaboratively with the thematic Technical Specialists, Country Directors and other staff to ensure consistency, cohesion and synergy in the application of technical advice and provision of programme development support.

**Position specifics:**  

The incumbent will strengthen PMI's capacity to support IFAD's Markets and Value Chains (MVC) and private sector engagement work. The Technical Specialist will provide technical expertise and operational support to country\-level and global operations, with a focus on the Agribusiness Linkages Facility (Agri\-Link), where the incumbent acts as focal point for, and supports coordination of Agri\-link activities, under the guidance of the Lead Global Technical Specialist, Markets and Value Chains PMI.


The incumbent supports the development and implementation of Agri\-Link, an initiative connecting IFAD donor partners, smallholder producers and the private sector. The role generates operational evidence and results to inform institutional decision\-making and strengthen IFAD's private sector engagement approach within its sovereign portfolio. The role is embedded within PMI (OTD) and contributes directly to IFAD corporate workstreams on private sector engagement in sovereign operations and may lead or coordinate related initiatives.


**Key Functions and Results**
-----------------------------



**1\.TECHNICAL ADVICE:** On the basis of seasoned technical knowledge and analysis of current thematic conditions, emerging development challenges and the state of rural poverty at the assigned country, regional and global levels, the incumbent provides sound technical advice to improve IFAD's s capacity to address rural poverty, to support national programmes and to enhance IFAD's reputation as a trusted and valued partner. Accountabilities may include:

* Providing relevant technical expertise in the identification, elaboration and assessment of technical opportunities, proposals and feasibility studies for development projects and programmes and monitoring their execution, in accordance with existing organization guidelines
* Participating in Project Development Teams (PDTs) and providing technical, analytical inputs to IFAD country strategic opportunity papers (COSOPs), project designs as well as to other policy documents related to rural development and poverty reduction; and
* Participating in project missions as necessary and pilot methods of analysis for IFAD projects Review proposals for small and large grants as required.

**2\. KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT**: The incumbent enhances the development of viable and sustainable policy and project development at the country\-level and supports regional thematic input through seasoned technical knowledge sharing for the area of specialization. The incumbent will ensure country\-level access to the latest sources of knowledge and innovation, strengthen national technical capacity and establish new knowledge and advisory partnerships. Accountabilities may include:

* Sharing knowledge and experiences generated through activities such as analytical studies and regional grants with colleagues in the country programme as well as the division;
* Conducting relevant knowledge development and dissemination with institutions outside of IFAD within the region concerned and national Institutions, disseminating knowledge and lessons learned with peers, counterparts and stakeholders through drafting of Occasional Papers, journal articles, seminars and workshops, through electronic media (e.g. web resource platforms and social media) and the development of new knowledge products and operational tools that are informed by learning from the field; and
* Participating in IFAD\-wide thematic discussions and developing appropriate technical and operational approaches of relevance to the country/divisional strategies and programmes.

**3\. PARTNERSHIP BUILDING AND RESOURCE MOBILIZATION:** The incumbent establishes and maintains a network of peer contacts inside and outside IFAD to keep up\-to\-date on activities at the country and regional levels, to support joint advocacy and for knowledge sharing to enhance the Fund's profile as a highly competent and viable partner in development. Accountabilities may include:

* Building partnerships with complementary technical organizations, NGOs, and specialized departments of other development agencies as potential operational and strategic partners at regional and country levels;
* Strengthening IFAD's representation and communication in technical issues in the relevant thematic area (including representing IFAD at international, regional, inter\-agency meetings, seminars and conferences I); and
* Mobilizing new resources for IFAD, in collaboration with the RBMO, through partnerships and outreach activities.

**4\. MONITORING, EVALUATION AND REPORTING:** The incumbent contributes to managing the monitoring, evaluation and reporting of technical activities and components of programs/projects in order to enhance country level programme and funding decisions based on accurate technical data. Accountabilities may include:

* Developing monitoring and evaluation criteria for technical components of programmes and projects;
* Implementing performance monitoring systems and new approaches to performance monitoring; and
* Preparing analytical findings and reports for divisional and country\-level decision making on project viability and sustainability.


5\. MANAGERIAL FUNCTIONS: The incumbent is accountable for integrity, transparency, and equity in the management of IFAD resources. This includes:

* People Management and evaluation of performance of consultants and staff under their purview.
* Resource Management by providing technical expertise for programme development, and Knowledge and Content Management by ensuring that:
* Knowledge content within specialty/thematic area is continuously updated and available through the intranet
* Best practices are continuously identified, documented and made available to clients and peers through the inter\-/intra\-net
* Appropriate and up\-to\-date information and learning tools are available.

**Position specifics:**


The Technical Specialist's (MVC Agri\-Link) main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**6\. Strategic design and management of Agri\-Link**

* Support the design, coordination and implementation of Agri\-Link interventions in partnership with private sector entities, ensuring alignment with IFAD country programme priorities, donor objectives and IFAD's private sector engagement strategy. This includes supporting the structuring and implementation of interventions that apply partnership models and contribute to approaches with potential for replication.
* Support the development and execution of private sector partnerships. This includes identification of partnership opportunities and private sector needs, facilitation of linkages between producer organizations and private firms, and supporting implementation of arrangements that strengthen inclusive and sustainable value chain integration.

**7\. Team leadership, budget stewardship \& delivery oversight**

* Provide technical guidance to local and international consultants, and coordination with staff supporting specific Agri\-Link bilateral agreements, ensuring alignment and consistency with agreed approaches of the Agri\-Link Facility.
* Support coordinated and consistent delivery across workstreams and donors by contributing to planning, coordination and quality assurance of technical inputs.
* Support financial planning and monitor budget utilization for Agri\-Link, in line with approved workplans, donor expectations and results frameworks.

**8\. Donor engagement, reporting \& knowledge leadership**

* Contribute to donor engagement processes, including impact reporting, results communication and preparation of strategic and operational documentation for Agri\-Link,
* Provide inputs as required to fundraising efforts and coordinate with GPR and relevant teams for Agri\-Link
* Consolidate and synthesize cross\-country operational evidence and lessons learned to support institutional learning, inform programme\-level decision\-making, and contribute to the scale\-up of successful models, in line with IFAD's private sector engagement strategy and in coordination with PSD.
* Support the documentation and dissemination of Agri\-Link results and tools to facilitate their replication or use in IFAD's sovereign operations, particularly in areas related to private sector engagements and markets and value chains.

**9\. Representation, partnerships \& institutional linkages**

* Participate in relevant internal and external meetings, technical forums and partnership engagements, representing Agri\-Link in a technical capacity and contributing subject\-matter expertise, as required.
* Build and maintain strong working relations with IFAD country programmes, sovereign operations and broader private sector engagement priorities, in coordination with relevant divisions and stakeholders.
* Support the development and strengthening of partnerships with private sector entities (in coordination with PSD), development partners, technical organizations, financial institutions and other relevant stakeholders to support Agri\-Link objectives and resource mobilization efforts.

**10\. Sovereign portfolio integration**

* Provide technical inputs to broader PMI and OTD workstreams related to markets and value chains, private sector engagement in sovereign operations and corporate initiatives, in coordination with relevant IFAD divisions and units.
* Contribute technical inputs to corporate initiatives and cross\-portfolio learning processes on private sector engagement
* Support other activities relating to the areas of expertise as required.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------



Assignments require the provision of seasoned technical expertise and input for the full programme/project cycle as well as in knowledge sharing with peers and counterparts. The work goes beyond technical analysis and synthesis to include substantive inputs to project methodology and design of projects, knowledge sharing among peers and counterparts to enhance cooperation, complementarity and synergy and monitoring and evaluation to measure and report on lessons learned and best practices. The work is considered moderately complex requiring in\-depth technical analysis and reporting. Typically operating as a technical specialist at the country or regional levels, the Technical Specialist's work may be reviewed for technical accuracy, but more typically is reviewed for achieving the established work plan.

**Position specifics:**  

The role entails supporting the expansion of the Agri\-Link Facility. Key performance Indicators include supporting the identification of private sector partners, implementation of partnerships, general publicity activities for the Agri\-Link Facility and support to fundraising with new and existing donors.


**Working Relationships**
-------------------------



The work relationships of the incumbent at this level are primarily for the exchange of information regarding development projects. Information\-gathering and exchange in support of studies and thematic assignments may also include identifying reliable sources and establishing guidelines for obtaining information on national and sub\-regional; conditions and to convey methodological approaches and operational experience for implementation of activities undertaken on behalf of the Fund.

**Position specifics:**  

The position will work directly with the Lead Global Technical Specialist (MVC), other Agri\-Link staff and consultants, and any other working relationships deemed relevant to the position.
